integrity: Exact symbolic proof of the full endomorphism normal form and enumeration; independently replayable finite tests; no assertion of absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Only nonempty-subset powers of finite rectangular bands; no classification of arbitrary finite semigroups or full powersets with empty set. Exact count is a finite function sum, not an asymptotic formula.
title: The full endomorphism monoid of a finite rectangular-band power semigroup
